parts.problem_md:
The concert venue uses an online booking system.

Gail uses different types of networks in her job.

Gail uses wired communication.

Explain **two** benefits of using a wired network.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Two explanations, each to include **two** linked points such as:
> 
> - Increases transmission speed (1) because wired connectivity has lower latency / greater bandwidth (1)
> - More reliable (1) because signal is shielded from other electromagnetic interference (1)
> - More secure (1) because receiver has to be physically connected to the sender (1)

parts.problem_md:
The venue promotes events on a website.

Gail uploads new images for the website.

Explain **one** reason why the image files should be compressed before uploading to the website.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> An explanation to include two from: 
> Compression reduces the amount of data used by the file (1) meaning there is less data to transfer (1) making the transfer faster/cheaper (1)
> 
> Check ‘smaller’ at STP

parts.problem_md:
Visitors usually bring a digital device to events at the venue.

The venue uses a barcode scanner that connects to the booking system.

The barcode scanner will be used in places where hundreds of mobile digital devices will be using wireless communication.

Explain the benefit of using wired communication rather than wireless communication between the barcode scanner and the booking system
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> An explanation to include two from:
> 
> - Less interference (1) because the wired signal is shielded / the wireless signal is not shielded (1)

parts.problem_md:
Camille creates a home network.

Camille uses wired and wireless connectivity.

State what is meant by ‘latency’.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Any one from:
> 
> - (Signal) delay/lag
> - The time taken for data/packets to be sent (between devices in a network)

parts.problem_md:
Camille shares family photographs online with friends.

Camille connects to a wireless access point to upload her photographs.

Explain **one** reason why moving closer to the wireless access point reduces transfer time.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> A linked explanation such as:
> 
> Data will not be lost / does not have to be sent/requested multiple times (1) because signal strength increases the closer you are to the WAP (1)
> 
> **Award **explanations phrased in the opposite, e.g.: 
> Data may have to be sent/requested again (1) because signal strength reduces the further away you are from the WAP (1)
> 
> Do not accept:
> 
> - Reference to speed/latency (as this is a repeat of the question)
> - ‘Strength of the connection’ for ‘signal strength’
> - Reference to interference being reduced as a result

parts.problem_md:
Camille’s child, Sarah, uses websites and video sharing sites for her school work.

Sarah participates in an online meeting as part of a lesson.

Sarah uses wired connectivity. Her video is not synchronised with video from other participants.

Which **one** of these would cause this issue?
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> **The correct answer is B** - Higher latency

parts.problem_md:
Joe streams a radio show online.

Joe must reduce latency when connecting an input device to a computer.

Which one of **these** is the best choice of connectivity for this?
Which one of these is the effect of latency?
parts.solution_md: **The correct answer is A **- Delayed sound

parts.problem_md:
Joe posts a link to the shows on an online community.

Explain** one** reason Joe does not upload posts that include videos when streaming a show.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> An explanation such as:
> 
> - It could negatively affect the audience experience / reduce stream quality (1) because (upstream) bandwidth is limited (1)
> - Data/bandwidth consumption is high when uploading (1) / because file size will be much greater (1)
> - It would take longer to upload videos (1) because bandwidth is being used for uploading stream data (1)

parts.problem_md:
Joe connects to different types of networks. Joe checks the new connection and gets these results: | 21.65

Mbps download | 0.07

Mbps upload | |---|---| Explain the impact these results have on the experience of Joe’s audience.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> An explanation such as: 
> Audience will experience pauses/delay/buffering/ lower quality audio (1) because the data upload speed / bandwidth is low (1)
> 
> Do not award: ‘latency/lag’ for ‘buffering’ 
> Award: ‘Takes longer for users to download data’ for MP2 
> Award: ‘The stream will not be smooth’ for MP1
